name: three-dimensional-genome-analysis
description: Analyze 3D genome organization from Hi-C data. Hi-C captures chromatin interactions by proximity ligation: crosslinked chromatin is digested with a restriction enzyme, ligated at proximity, and sequenced. Contact matrices reveal topologically associating domains (TADs), A/B compartments (active/inactive chromatin), and chromatin loops (enhancer-promoter contacts). Analysis uses HiC-Pro for processing and cooltools/HiCExplorer for downstream analysis.
